lineage.source: main_case_lineage_2026_10_05/derived/v5_summary.json (sets.set.arms.<arm>: band_bn, c3_line, counts), re-based on main_case_2026_10_14/derived/summary.json (v7.companions.options)

rebase.rule: whole-case arm bands; symmetric C3 +/- SE runs carry every item, including lineage credits and job capital; arms a/c scale the central C3 slope by their G3-rate count [APPROX]

pension_switch.rule: the union-side identities on v6's meta.pension_accrual: social_security less the lineage's (its cells and the items' lineage_* parts) is ratio_net x the union's OASDI receipts, and medicare less the lineage's, less part_a_accrual_bn, is (1 - part_a_share) of the cash set's union amount (1e-9); the lineage's social_security moves with its own OASDI receipts at k, and its Part A accrual is fixed like the union's

row4_frame.rule: R9: subtract named union parts before v6 identity checks; actual union SS shifts follow OASDI receipts and Part A shifts are fixed; lineage parts keep their own accrual ratio/fixed Part A

items.route: the lineage's cells, re-valued in place, ride each line's first-order ratio as v5's do [ASSUMPTION, oct05's]
the case's group total uses its personal specifications (R5)

capital.route: each offset's key is its carrier's share, a fixed key shift the item sets: it enters the capital return's rebuild (kcoef_<tag>_share_<carrier>) and carries no sampling error [ASSUMPTION: v4's rule for correction lines the uncorrected model lacks]

source.verdict: Taxes on the business capital that serves the group's jobs come to **$66.5bn a year at the band's low end

source_se_bn.rule: SDR over the 160 replicate weights (the CPS sample); fill_in from the fill-in rel_change SE

job_capital_sampling.rule: producer's 161-weight vectors, points and per-line/joint SDR gated against item.json (1e-9); corporate's two lines share one vector; joint with the account and benefit keys at matching pwwgt columns; lineage dollars ride the line's first-order ratio [ASSUMPTION]
